positions.insights: Skills: Swift (Programming Language) · SwiftUI · UIKit · Python (Programming Language) · Xcode · iOS Development · QA Automation · macOS · User Interface Design · User Experience Design (UED) · iOS · iOS Testing · Containerization · Migration Projects

positions.title: Solutions Architect Intern
positions.description:
• Worked under the AWS Global Financial Services organization
• Experienced developing with AWS Lambda, Amazon Textract, Amazon Comprehend and Amazon S3
• Implemented Personal Identifiable Information (PII) redaction solution within a pre-existing document processing pipeline utilizing Natural Language Processing (NLP) concepts
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon Comprehend · Amazon SQS · JSON · AWS Lambda · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · Amazon Textract · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon S3

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Prototyped exploratory work to improve drag and drop functionality, accessibility and security on the iOS/iPadOS
• Developed an application using the UIKit framework in the Swift language through Xcode to implement a new feature 
• Actively integrated feedback from the UIKit, SpringBoard and Human Interface teams to enhance the feature
• Demonstrated proof of concept and project’s findings to organization executives and team leads with positive reception
positions.insights: Skills: iOS Development · UIKit · Xcode · Swift (Programming Language)

positions.title: Real-time Defect Analysis (RDA) Data Systems Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Architected a new data visualization dashboard with additional custom functionalities to migrate from Tableau reports
• Constructed using Python through a Django rest framework for backend components hosted on a Linux server
• Developed REST APIs to automate data analysis process of defect trends throughout the semiconductor production steps
• Optimized user interface with Angular and Bootstrap frameworks to increase analysis rates and efficiency while facilitating access and usability for a wider range of employees across nine departments
positions.insights: Skills: JSON · Django · Angular · Django REST Framework · SQL · Bootstrap · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Chapter President
positions.description:
• Earned the Regional Blue Chip Chapter Award for organizing over 30 engaging events targeting professional, academic, leadership and chapter development
• Raised $11,000 through department meetings to arrange sponsorship for members to attend SHPE 2019 National Convention 
• Recruited nearly 100 new chapter members within two months, which increased the membership rate by 180%
• Established strong partnerships with engineering companies/student organizations to host networking/informational events

certifications.name: Certified Chapter Leader of the George Mason University Chapter
certifications.title: Certified Chapter Leader of the George Mason University Chapter

honors.title: SHPE Region 4 Blue Chip Chapter Award
honors.description: Award obtained as President for the SHPE George Mason University Chapter for successfully executing chapter events and increasing membership recruitment and retention rates, while increasing professional and academic development resources for our members
honors.issuer: Issued by Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers (SHPE) · Mar 2020

honors.title: HSF 2019 STEM Summit Attendee
honors.description: Every year the Hispanic Scholarship Fund receives more than 120,000 applications for scholarships, and of the chosen 10,000 that become HSF Scholars, 100 are chosen to attend the HSF STEM Summit. The HSF STEM Summit is an annual conference that gives the best and brightest HSF STEM Scholars an inside track to career success in STEM fields, through a combination of mentoring, professional insights, and career guidance.
honors.issuer: Issued by Hispanic Scholarship Fund · Sep 2019
